basic_details.scholarship_name: Chulalongkorn University Graduate Scholarship for Non-ASEAN Countries
basic_details.offering_entity: Chulalongkorn University Graduate School & Office of International Affairs
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Chulalongkorn University Main Campus (Pathumwan, Bangkok, Thailand)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Science, Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Faculty of Allied Health Sciences, Petroleum and Petrochemical College (PPC), and Chulalongkorn School of Integrated Innovation (ScII) - all international graduate degree programs.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~50 to 80 Graduate Scholarships for Non-ASEAN Countries awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to non-ASEAN developing nations; typically 6 to 12 Pakistani researchers in engineering, petroleum, and health sciences selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 3 years for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: Monthly living stipend of THB 16,000 / month (~PKR 120,000 / month) plus 100% full tuition fee waiver, economy class round-trip airfare, and accommodation allowance of THB 7,000 / month at Chulalongkorn University International House (CU iHouse)

nationality_requirements: International graduate students from non-ASEAN countries (Pakistan fully eligible; ASEAN citizens apply under separate ASEAN track)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must not be over 40 years of age at the time of application.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (for Master's) with minimum CGPA 3.25/4.00, or completed recognized 18-year Master's degree (for PhD) with minimum CGPA 3.50/4.00 from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.25 / 4.00 for Master's; minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 for PhD; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.55 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Chemical engineering, petroleum engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, biomedical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, or materials science.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree requirements before semester commencement.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals provide a significant competitive advantage.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0, TOEFL iBT minimum 79, CU-TEP minimum 75, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited degree-granting institution.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Thai language proficiency is NOT required; all international degree programs are taught 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply through their target Chulalongkorn faculty/program, which then nominates shortlisted candidates to the Office of International Affairs.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another concurrent scholarship or fellowship covering identical tuition and living costs.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver and special academic fees covered for standard degree duration at Chulalongkorn University.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~THB 300,000 to 500,000 / year value; ~PKR 2,250,000 to 3,750,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Chulalongkorn faculty application processing fee of THB 1,000 paid during online portal submission.

accommodation.details: Dedicated monthly accommodation allowance of THB 7,000 / month provided to cover room rental at Chulalongkorn University International House (CU iHouse).

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend of THB 16,000 / month (~PKR 120,000 / month) disbursed directly to the scholar's bank account.

airfare.details: Economy-class round-trip international airfare between Pakistan and Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport provided by the scholarship.

visa_fee.details: Thai Non-Immigrant ED Student Visa fee paid directly to the Royal Thai Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Chulalongkorn University Health Service Center healthcare and comprehensive group medical insurance plan.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized cafeterias across Chulalongkorn campus, including certified halal dining options; meals cost THB 35 to 60.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Chulalongkorn Central Library (Thailand's premier academic library), supercomputing resources, and national petrochemical testing centers.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Graduate School Overseas Presentation Grant supports international conference presentation of thesis research.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to THB 20,000 conference travel funding

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free CU Pop Bus (electric shuttle transit) connecting all campus faculties, CU iHouse, Siam BTS station, and Sam Yan MRT station.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single Thailand #1 premier flagship comprehensive university (Chulalongkorn University - Chula).
participating_institutions: Chulalongkorn University Main Campus (Pathumwan, Central Bangkok, Thailand)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #229 globally, #1 in Thailand for 15 consecutive years; world-renowned for chemical engineering, petroleum technology, medicine, and materials science.
available_majors: Master's / PhD in Petroleum and Petrochemical Technology (PPC)
Master's / PhD in Computer Science and Information Technology
Master's / PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences and Technology
Master's / PhD in Materials Science and Engineering
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with CGPA >= 3.25/4.00 (Master's) or 3.50/4.00 (PhD), academic transcripts, research proposal, two recommendation letters, medical certificate, and English proficiency test (IELTS 6.0+ / TOEFL 79+ / MOI).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Petroleum and Petrochemical College (PPC, partnered with Univ of Michigan and Univ of Oklahoma) and Faculty of Engineering are highly selective; contacting prospective supervisors in advance strongly aids faculty nomination.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus research proposals on polymer chemistry, sustainable petrochemicals, biomaterials, or green energy catalysis where Chulalongkorn leads Southeast Asia.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Chulalongkorn University International Graduate Scholarship Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Identify target international program, download Non-ASEAN scholarship application form, submit admission and scholarship dossier to the program coordinator/faculty by the deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check target international graduate program at Chulalongkorn University and contact program coordinator.
Step 2: Complete the Application Form for Graduate Scholarship Programme for Non-ASEAN Countries.
Step 3: Compile transcripts, degree certificates, research proposal, medical certificate, CV, and English test scores.
Step 4: Submit complete application dossier to the relevant Faculty/Program at Chulalongkorn University before the faculty deadline (typically February-March).
Step 5: Faculty evaluates academic credentials and conducts online technical interviews.
Step 6: Faculty selects top candidates and nominates them to the University Scholarship Committee.
Step 7: Office of International Affairs issues official award notification in May.
Step 8: Receive admission letter, apply for Thai Non-Immigrant ED Visa at Thai Embassy in Islamabad, and book flight provided by Chulalongkorn.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Faculty-to-University Route: Application submitted directly to target faculty, which screens applicants and forwards nominations to central university scholarship board.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted as two confidential recommendation letters signed by university professors in sealed envelopes or sent directly via official institutional email.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose describing academic background, research interests, career vision, and why Chulalongkorn University is the desired destination.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research proposal (2-4 pages) detailing problem formulation, methodology, literature review, and anticipated contributions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Comprehensive academic CV detailing education, laboratory techniques, research publications, and awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental doctoral admission committee.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 79+, CU-TEP 75+, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified true copies of transcripts and degree certificates; HEC and MoFA attestations recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified official English translation for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Submission of application dossier to target faculty/program graduate office.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete Bachelor's / Master's degree certificates and transcripts with CGPA >= 3.25 (Master's) or 3.50 (PhD).
Official prescribed application form completed in English with passport-style photograph.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Detailed Statement of Purpose and Research Proposal
required_documents_checklist.specification: 2-4 page structured proposal outlining proposed research problem and methodology.
Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors on institutional letterhead.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed and stamped with official university seals.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official medical certificate completed and signed by an authorized physician within past 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by recognized hospital or diagnostic laboratory.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 79+, CU-TEP 75+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.
Academic resume and clear color copy of international passport bio-data page valid for at least 18 months.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: February 28 (Faculty submission deadline for August intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for August intake; application deadline to faculties is strictly late February.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior CGPA, academic consistency in STEM fields)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Research proposal rigor, engineering problem solving, and technical depth)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of vision and alignment with faculty priorities)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Technical interview performance with prospective supervisor and faculty panel)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty Graduate Committee, School Deans, and Chulalongkorn University Scholarship Selection Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: departmental technical vetting of research alignment followed by central university award confirmation.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~10.0% to 14.0% for candidates with strong engineering/science backgrounds and CGPA >= 3.55
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate/Master's CGPA >= 3.55 / 4.00, accompanied by strong laboratory foundations
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in chemical engineering, petroleum, materials, computing, or pharmaceutical sciences with solid research proposals.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani universities (NUST, UET Lahore, NED Karachi, Quaid-i-Azam, FAST-NUCES, COMSATS).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Egypt, Nigeria, Russia, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portals academic.chula.ac.th and inter.chula.ac.th.
Chulalongkorn does not work with third-party agents; all applications must be submitted directly to target faculties.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Faculty application processing fee of THB 1,000 is paid directly through secure university banking channels.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agency written proposals are rejected; applicants must write their own research proposals.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Thai Student Visa fee in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000.
HEC document attestation in Pakistan: ~PKR 10,000 to 15,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend cycle: ~THB 10,000 (~PKR 75,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Thai language is required. Reality: All international programs at Chulalongkorn are conducted 100% in English.
Myth: Flights are self-funded. Reality: The Non-ASEAN scholarship explicitly covers economy class round-trip international airfare.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites suggest accommodation is not funded; the scholarship provides a dedicated THB 7,000/month accommodation allowance.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum semester GPA of 3.25 out of 4.00 throughout degree study.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research presence at Chulalongkorn campus; residence at CU iHouse or nearby university housing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual progress report evaluated by academic advisor and presented to Graduate School.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in outside employment during the study period.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are free to seek international careers, postdoc opportunities, or industrial employment globally upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of scholarship if GPA falls below required standard or for academic misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Field of study cannot be changed after enrollment.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum tenure is 2 years (Master's) and 3 years (PhD); extensions are generally not funded by the scholarship.
